name: Matei Josephs
biography: Matei is a Senior Penetration Tester who loves exploring the internet for vulnerabilities. Matei has discovered several CVEs and has the OSCP, CRTO, eWPT and a few other certifications alongside a Master's degree in Cybercrime and Intelligence. Although his daily job requires him to conduct thorough tests across a limited scope, after work, Matei enjoys doing simple tests across the whole internet.
